#!/bin/sh
# Nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data from node2 to dated archives on node1.
set -e

BACKUP_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
SRC_HOST=node2
SRC_PATH=/srv/inventory/data
DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
DEST="$BACKUP_DIR/inventory-$DATE.tar.gz"
RETAIN_DAYS=7

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

TMP_DEST="$DEST.partial"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes "$SRC_HOST" "tar -czf - -C $(dirname "$SRC_PATH") $(basename "$SRC_PATH")" > "$TMP_DEST"
mv "$TMP_DEST" "$DEST"

find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -mtime +$((RETAIN_DAYS - 1)) -delete

echo "Backup complete: $DEST"

/usr/bin/crontab
